provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS original capability gap-closure master pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A policy with neither object-src nor default-src leaves plugin and object loading unconstrained, which the fallback-aware rule must report.

groundTruth.rationale: object-src is a fetch directive that inherits default-src; with neither declared, object loading has no source restriction.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live page.
The finding states that object loading is unconstrained by the policy, not that a plugin is present.
